fact_text: A daily candlestick records four prices for the session: the open, the high, the low and the close.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2. Mastering Candlestick Charts: Understanding Bearish & Bullish Candles | PSX Stock Analysis Guide' (YouTube, 2024-08-16)

fact_text: In a bearish (red) candle the price opens near the top of the session's range and closes lower, showing that sellers dominated the session.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2. Mastering Candlestick Charts: Understanding Bearish & Bullish Candles | PSX Stock Analysis Guide' (YouTube, 2024-08-16)

fact_text: In a bullish (green) candle the price opens at the bottom of the session's range and closes higher, showing that buyers dominated the session.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2. Mastering Candlestick Charts: Understanding Bearish & Bullish Candles | PSX Stock Analysis Guide' (YouTube, 2024-08-16)

fact_text: The thin lines above and below a candle's body, called wicks or shadows, show how far price traded beyond the open and close during the session.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2. Mastering Candlestick Charts: Understanding Bearish & Bullish Candles | PSX Stock Analysis Guide' (YouTube, 2024-08-16)

fact_text: Signals written on a closing basis require the candle to close beyond the level, so a wick that touches the level intraday does not count as a breakout.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2. Mastering Candlestick Charts: Understanding Bearish & Bullish Candles | PSX Stock Analysis Guide' (YouTube, 2024-08-16)

fact_text: A close beyond a level is treated as confirmed only if the candle that follows it also closes beyond that level; otherwise the close is not confirmed.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2. Mastering Candlestick Charts: Understanding Bearish & Bullish Candles | PSX Stock Analysis Guide' (YouTube, 2024-08-16)

fact_text: Candlesticks are read as a gauge of buyer and seller sentiment: mostly bearish candles suggest sellers dominate, while mostly bullish candles suggest buyers dominate.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '2. Mastering Candlestick Charts: Understanding Bearish & Bullish Candles | PSX Stock Analysis Guide' (YouTube, 2024-08-16)
